title: Tabs and accordions
description: Switch between tabs and expand or collapse accordion sections, some of which keep their hidden content in the page and some of which remove it.
notes-label: Notes (switch tabs and come back to see if they are kept)

product.title: Tabs that keep hidden panels
product.explanation: Every panel is in the page, but only the selected one is visible. The Reviews tab loads after a short delay and the Archive tab is disabled.
product.label: Product details

panels.overview: The Trailblazer backpack holds 28 litres and has a padded laptop sleeve.
panels.specifications: Weight: 1.2 kg. Dimensions: 50 × 30 × 20 cm. Material: recycled nylon.
panels.archive: Older models are no longer available.

reviews.2: “The laptop sleeve fits a 16-inch laptop.” 4 stars

report.title: Tabs that render only the selected panel
report.explanation: Only the selected panel is in the page. The others are removed, along with anything typed into them.
report.label: Report period

faq.title: Accordion with one section open at a time
faq.explanation: Opening a section closes the one that was open. Clicking the open section closes it.

shipping.title: How long does shipping take?
shipping.body: Orders arrive within 3 to 5 working days.

returns.title: Can I return an item?
returns.body: Yes, within 30 days of delivery, as long as it is unused.

warranty.title: Is there a warranty?
warranty.body: Every product has a two-year warranty against defects.

settings.title: Accordion with several sections open
settings.explanation: Any number of sections can be open at once.

profile.title: Profile
profile.body: Your name and photo are shown to other users.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Email notifications are sent once a day.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Your profile is visible only to people you follow.

details.title: Native disclosure
details.explanation: The browser's own <details> and <summary> elements, for comparison. One starts closed and one starts open.
details.closed-body: A control that shows and hides a section of content.
details.open-summary: Why compare with the native element?
details.open-body: It needs no script and no ARIA, but its state is the open attribute rather than aria-expanded.
